products.title: Acer palmatum 'English Lace' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'English Lace' Upright Red Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 The holy grail of Japanese maples! 'English Lace' is a brand new laceleaf selection that is the tallest of any of the red dissectums. That's right, I said it gets upright growth and it is a laceleaf. It also gets some width with age. This selection leafs out in the early spring with a rich burgundy dissected leaf. This gives a soft appearance to a mid-sized tree. This selection grows upward reaching 10-12 ft in height by 15 ft in width in 15 years. Fall colors are bright oranges to reds. Like
